title: The RED KING
description: This is a mod made with Autoforge. It contains a BOSS that can be naturally summoned called "The Red King".
body:
This is a mod that adds a new BOSS to the game called "_The red king_". It can be summoned naturally at night in the _overworld_. Kill it and get items called "_Burger_". If u eat a burger, then u can get **POWER Lv.5** and **REGENERATION Lv.5**, which can make u unstoppable!
The inspiration of this mod is a Chinese student's composition called "The Scars of War", which tells a story about The Red King and a student who likes eating burgers, so this mod is created to commemorate the humourous and abstract passage.
The Red King has 200HP and 16 ATK, it can also shoot fireballs towards players. So pls make sure that u have armory that is powerful enough.
